lines.text: Elders who lead effectively are worthy of double honor, and Scripture says not to muzzle an ox treading out the grain.
An accusation against an elder needs two or three witnesses, and those who persist in sin are rebuked in front of everyone.
Paul charges Timothy before God, Christ Jesus and the elect angels to maintain these principles without bias.
Timothy is told not to be too quick with the laying on of hands, and to use a little milk instead of water.
Slaves should honor their masters so God's name is not discredited, and serve believing masters all the more because they are neighbors.
